property_summary: For any admissible input, a CashOut of _am when _am <= the caller's balance never reverts (balance is deducted before the external call, so reentrants see the reduced balance); the mutant deducts after the call, so a reentrant second CashOut underflows and the outer CashOut reverts, breaking the rule.
After fully cashing out, a Deposit of value v (> MinDeposit) must credit exactly v to the depositor's balance.
